functions.name: decodeUtf8ToUtf32
functions.signature: (type $t14) (param i32 i32 i32 i32 i32 i32 i32 i32) (result i32)
functions.notes: UTF-8 to UTF-32 decoder: returns 0 at source end, 1 on destination-slot exhaustion or truncated sequence, 2 on invalid UTF-8; writes final cursors through out-pointers and mirrors frame cursor words. Capacity is per 32-bit slot.

functions.name: encodeUtf32ToUtf8
functions.signature: (type $t14) (param i32 i32 i32 i32 i32 i32 i32 i32) (result i32)
functions.notes: UTF-32 to UTF-8 encoder: returns 0 at source end, 1 when the next complete sequence does not fit, 2 for a surrogate or value above U+10FFFF; writes final cursors through out-pointers and mirrors frame cursor words.
